scope: MVP — 6 PII pattern families. Deferred: see docs/pii-patterns.md §'Deferred patterns'.

engineDefaults.suppressionRule: Patterns marked columnContextSuppression=true skip cells in columns whose header (case-insensitive) contains any token in columnSuppressionTokens. Patterns marked false run in all columns.

patterns.label: Possible email address
patterns.sourceUrl: RFC 5322 (informal subset; accepts + aliases, rejects quoted locals and IP-literal domains)
patterns.rationale: Single most common PII cell. ~0.1% FP on business CSVs (version strings, dotted paths). Per-cell default.

patterns.label: Possible phone number (E.164)
patterns.validation: structural: total length 8–15 digits, leading +, first country-code digit 1–9
patterns.rationale: Strict E.164 only. Display-format phones handled by phone-display. Run first so phone-display does not re-flag E.164 matches.

patterns.label: Possible phone number (display format — higher false-positive risk)
patterns.rationale: Catches real-world formatted numbers. Highest-FP pattern in the list. Cells matching phone-e164 are suppressed here.

patterns.label: Possible credit card number (Luhn-valid)
patterns.validation: Luhn mod-10 (ISO/IEC 7812-1). Strip non-digits from the match before checking. Test BINs in engineDefaults.testBinList are caught and dropped with label 'Test card number discarded', not flagged.
patterns.rationale: Luhn is the load-bearing filter. No column suppression needed; precision is high enough.

patterns.label: Possible IBAN (mod-97 valid)
patterns.validation: mod-97 (ISO 13616). Length pre-check against per-country table; reject if country-code length does not match. JS BigInt used for chunked-mod to avoid >16-digit precision loss.
patterns.rationale: mod-97 + per-country length table is precision enough. No column suppression. Lowercase IBANs normalized before regex; spaces stripped.

patterns.label: Possible US SSN (shape only — no checksum)
patterns.validation: structural only. Post-match filter rejects area 000, group 00, serial 0000, area 666, area 900–999 (SSA never issues these).
patterns.rationale: Bare-9 regex is too noisy; hyphenated form is the realistic SSN shape in CSVs. Phone regex runs first; SSN matches in phone-positive cells are suppressed.

patterns.label: Possible UK National Insurance Number (shape only)
patterns.validation: structural only. NINo prefix validity rules in regex: no D, F, I, Q, U, V as start; no O as second char.
patterns.rationale: Tight shape, near-zero false negatives, low FP. 30-line addition; cheap insurance for UK users.
